info.title: Mermaid Parser
info.description: Universal Mermaid diagram parser supporting 20+ diagram types (ERD, Class, Flowchart, Sequence, State, Gantt, Timeline, Mindmap, etc.) with comprehensive validation and syntax checking. Extract structured data from any Mermaid diagram and convert to multiple output formats including JSON Schema, SQL DDL, TypeScript, C#, Python, GraphQL, and more. Perfect for documentation analysis, data modeling, and workflow automation.

post.description: Parse any Mermaid diagram (20+ types including ERD, Class, Flowchart, Sequence, State, Gantt, Timeline, Mindmap, Architecture, and more) into structured data with comprehensive validation, entity extraction, relationship analysis, and syntax checking.

mermaidContent.description: The complete Mermaid diagram content supporting ERD, Class, Flowchart, Sequence, State, Gantt, C4Context, Mindmap, Timeline, Quadrant, and 13+ other diagram types with advanced parsing for inheritance, methods, visibility modifiers, and relationship labels.

validateSyntax.description: Perform comprehensive syntax validation including brace matching, orphaned relationship detection, empty entity warnings, and context-aware error reporting.

detectCDM.description: Automatically detect matching Common Data Model entities for ERD diagrams with confidence scoring and attribute mapping.

200.description: Mermaid diagram successfully parsed and processed

success.description: Indicates whether the diagram parsing operation completed successfully.

entities.description: Array of entities extracted from the Mermaid diagram with their attributes and properties.

name.description: The name of the parsed entity from the Mermaid diagram.

logicalName.description: The logical name of the entity, typically in snake_case format.

entityType.description: The type of entity: Table, Class, Interface, AbstractClass, or Entity.

baseClass.description: The base class this entity inherits from (for class diagrams).

interfaces.description: Array of interfaces this entity implements (for class diagrams).

attributes.description: Array of attributes or fields that belong to this entity.

name.description: The name of the entity attribute or field.

dataType.description: The data type of the attribute, such as string, int, boolean, or date.

visibility.description: The visibility modifier: public, private, protected, or package.

isStatic.description: Indicates whether the attribute is static.

isReadOnly.description: Indicates whether the attribute is read-only.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the attribute.

constraints.description: Array of constraints like PK, FK, UK, NOT_NULL.

isPrimaryKey.description: Indicates whether this attribute is a primary key.

isForeignKey.description: Indicates whether this attribute is a foreign key.

isUnique.description: Indicates whether this attribute has a unique constraint.

isNullable.description: Indicates whether this attribute can be null.

methods.description: Array of methods that belong to this entity (for class diagrams).

returnType.description: The return type of the method.

visibility.description: The visibility modifier: public, private, protected, or package.

isStatic.description: Indicates whether the method is static.

isAbstract.description: Indicates whether the method is abstract.

parameters.description: Array of parameters for this method.

dataType.description: The data type of the parameter.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the parameter.

metadata.description: Additional metadata properties for the entity.

diagramType.description: The type of Mermaid diagram that was detected using advanced pattern recognition: ERD, Class, Flowchart, Sequence, State, Gantt, Pie, User Journey, Git Graph, C4Context, Mindmap, Timeline, Quadrant, or other supported types.

relationships.description: Array of relationships between entities as defined in the Mermaid diagram with enhanced context and metadata.

from.description: The source entity in the relationship.

to.description: The target entity in the relationship.

type.description: The type of relationship: one-to-many, many-to-one, one-to-one, many-to-many, inheritance, composition, aggregation, dependency, association, or other types.

label.description: The label or description text associated with the relationship.

context.description: The diagram context where this relationship was found: ERD, Class, Flow, or Generic.

foreignKeyField.description: The foreign key field name if applicable.

cardinality.description: The cardinality notation of the relationship (e.g., 1:N, M:N).

isOptional.description: Indicates whether the relationship is optional.

metadata.description: Additional metadata properties for the relationship.

validation.description: Results of syntax validation performed on the Mermaid diagram content.

isValid.description: Indicates whether the diagram syntax is valid and error-free.

errors.description: Array of error messages found during syntax validation.

warnings.description: Array of warning messages found during syntax validation.

cdmDetection.description: Common Data Model entity detection results that are generated for ERD diagrams.

detectedEntities.description: Array of entities that match Common Data Model entities with confidence scores.

entityName.description: The name of the entity from the diagram that was matched to a CDM entity.

cdmMatch.description: The name of the matching Common Data Model entity.

confidence.description: The confidence score of the CDM match, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0.

400.description: Invalid diagram content or request parameters

code.description: The specific error code identifying the type of error that occurred.

message.description: A detailed error message describing what went wrong during processing.

post.description: Convert parsed Mermaid diagram entities and relationships to 18+ development platform formats including JSON Schema, SQL DDL, TypeScript, C#, Python, Java, Go, Rust, GraphQL, React, Vue, Swift, Dataverse Schema, Microsoft Platform Formulas, PostgreSQL DDL, MySQL DDL, Mongoose Schema, and Markdown documentation. Supports enhanced entity properties, methods, inheritance, and relationship metadata.

entities.description: Array of entities that were returned from the ParseMermaidDiagram operation.

name.description: The name of the entity to be converted.

logicalName.description: The logical name of the entity, typically in lowercase format.

attributes.description: Array of attributes or fields that belong to this entity.

name.description: The name of the entity attribute or field.

dataType.description: The data type of the attribute, such as string, int, boolean, or date.

relationships.description: Array of relationships that were returned from the ParseMermaidDiagram operation (optional).

from.description: The source entity in the relationship.

to.description: The target entity in the relationship.

type.description: The type of relationship, such as one-to-many, many-to-one, or one-to-one.

outputFormat.description: Specific format to generate, or 'all' to generate all 18 available formats with enhanced entity and relationship support.

success.description: Indicates whether the conversion operation completed successfully.

conversions.description: Generated format conversions for the provided entities in multiple development platform formats with inheritance support.

jsonSchema.description: Proper JSON Schema Draft 07 specification with $schema, definitions, and typed properties.

sqlDDL.description: SQL CREATE TABLE statements with proper syntax for database schema creation.

typescript.description: TypeScript interface definitions with inheritance support (extends keyword).

csharp.description: C# class definitions with inheritance support and properties for .NET development.

python.description: Python dataclass definitions with inheritance support and type hints.

java.description: Java class definitions with inheritance (extends) for enterprise development.

go.description: Go struct definitions with JSON tags for cloud and microservices development.

rust.description: Rust struct definitions with Serde annotations for performance-critical applications.

graphql.description: GraphQL type definitions for modern API development.

react.description: React TypeScript component interfaces and prop definitions for frontend development.

vue.description: Vue.js Composition API type definitions for reactive frontend development.

swift.description: Swift model definitions with Codable protocol for iOS development.

dataverseSchema.description: Microsoft Dataverse table schema definition for Power Platform integration.

microsoftPlatformFormulas.description: Microsoft Platform collection formulas for creating data structures in low-code applications.

postgresqlDDL.description: PostgreSQL-specific Data Definition Language statements with advanced features.

mysqlDDL.description: MySQL-specific Data Definition Language statements with engine optimizations.

mongooseSchema.description: Mongoose schema definitions for MongoDB and Node.js development.

markdown.description: Markdown table format with inheritance indicators for documentation purposes.

post.description: Access advanced Mermaid parsing tools through Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC 2.0 interface. Supports 6 specialized tools: parse_mermaid_diagram, convert_to_formats, validate_mermaid_syntax, detect_diagram_type, extract_entities, and extract_relationships with comprehensive enterprise-grade parsing capabilities.
